notModeled: analog input, reference, IREF/CM biasing (the result is always the 0 V code: 0x2000 offset binary at DFS low, 0 two's complement at DFS high)

DFS is a 4-level strap (fractions of AVDD): it selects straight offset binary / two's complement AND the CLKOUT polarity (data valid on CLKOUT rising or falling edge); only the format is modeled (low = offset binary, high = two's complement), CLKOUT is always non-inverted; the two middle levels cannot be expressed

pipeline latency 17.5 clock cycles not modeled (the code is constant); data valid tSTART (max 5.0 ns) after the input clock rising edge, CLKOUT tPDI later; OVR (over-range) is driven as the top data bit, always 0 at 0 V
CLKP/CLKM are a differential (or single-ended) sampling clock: the model clocks on CLKP alone

the serial port is write-only (no read-back pin); the schema needs a MISO pin, so SDATA is named as both MOSI and MISO with out/idle z (the part never drives it); words beyond a multiple of 16 bits are ignored
test modes TP<1:0> (outputs forced to 0 / 1 / toggling) are stored only, they do not change the outputs
PDN power-down: the model blocks conversions; the datasheet puts the outputs in high impedance (not modeled) and the bus stays usable; power-down by clock below 2 MSPS not modeled
RESET has an internal 200 kOhm pull-up to AVDD (a floating RESET pin reads inactive in the model); RESET timing (2 us pulse, 10 ms after power-on) not modeled
OE to stable timing (1000 clock cycles) and wake-up times not modeled
OE, DFS, SEN, SDATA, SCLK clamp to DRVDD; RESET is referred to AVDD
